page.overview:
Who is Buddy?

is an ogre fighter and a member of the Darrington Brigade. He is played by Liam O'Brien.

Buddy is a large ogre standing at 9 feet tall, though he is usually hunched over and moves very slowly. Before joining the Brigade officially Buddy had terrible eyesight and always squinted to see, but after receiving special goggles his eyes seemed cartoonishly large. He wears a hulking metal breastplate and on his back sits Taryon's prototype electrically-charged chariot-turned comfortable seating where Macaroni usually sits. Before this Macaroni sat on a plank of wood tied to Buddy's back and shoulders.

Buddy is slow, lumbering and not very intelligent but clearly has a gentler side - upon receiving the goggles that allowed him to see for the first time, Buddy continuously pointed out how 'pretty' everything and everyone was. He also seemed more interested in making friends than fighting during the Brigade's initiation.

While the specifics are unknown, Buddy and Macaroni Samsonite met and became friends before joining the Darrington Brigade.
